and

---

**1. Appointment and Position**  
The Employer hereby appoints the Employee to the position of **IT Operations Analyst**, and the Employee accepts such appointment, effective from **[Start Date]**. The Employee shall perform the duties and responsibilities customary to this role, including but not limited to monitoring IT systems, troubleshooting operational issues, ensuring system reliability, supporting infrastructure upgrades, and complying with internal reporting protocols.

---

The Employee’s primary place of work shall be **remote**, with performance of duties conducted from a location within Haryana, India, as agreed between the parties. The Employee shall ensure a secure, functional, and professional work environment at the remote location and remain accessible during scheduled working hours. The Employer reserves the right to require occasional in-person attendance at a designated office or facility in Haryana, with reasonable prior notice.

---

**3. Fixed Annual Salary**  
The Employee shall receive a fixed annual salary of **INR 2,175,000 (Indian Rupees Twenty-One Lakh Seventy-Five Thousand Only)**, payable in equal monthly installments in accordance with the Employer’s standard payroll schedule, subject to applicable statutory deductions and withholdings.

---

**4. Probation Period**  
The Employee shall serve a probationary period of **four (4) months**, commencing on the effective date of employment. During this period, either party may terminate the employment with **thirty (30) days’ written notice** or payment in lieu, without further liability, subject to applicable law. Upon satisfactory completion of the probation period, the Employee’s position shall be confirmed in writing by the Employer.

---

**5. Working Time**  
The Employee shall render **thirty-five (35) scheduled hours** of work per week, distributed across five (5) working days. The standard working schedule shall be determined in consultation with the Employer, with flexibility to accommodate operational needs. The Employee shall maintain accurate records of work hours as required by company policy and applicable law.

---

**6. Leave Entitlement**  
The Employee shall be entitled to paid leave in accordance with applicable statutory provisions under the **Haryana Shops and Commercial Establishments Act, 1958**, and other relevant laws, including but not limited to:

- Earned leave as per applicable law  
- Sick leave as per statutory entitlement  
- Casual leave as per statutory requirements  
- Public and festival holidays observed by the Employer

Leave shall be availed with prior approval and in compliance with internal leave procedures.

---

**7. Statutory Benefits**  
The Employee shall be entitled to statutory benefits as mandated under Indian law, including but not limited to:

- Employees’ Provident Fund (EPF) contributions under the Employees’ Provident Funds and Miscellaneous Provisions Act, 1952  
- Employees’ State Insurance (ESI), if applicable based on salary threshold and employee count  
- Gratuity under the Payment of Gratuity Act, 1972, upon completion of eligible service  
- Other benefits as required by applicable labour laws in Haryana and India

The Employer shall comply with all statutory obligations in relation to deductions, contributions, and filings.

---

**8. Confidentiality**  
The Employee shall not, during or after employment, disclose or use any confidential information, trade secrets, technical data, business strategies, or client information obtained during employment, except as necessary to perform duties or as authorized in writing by the Employer. This obligation shall continue after termination of employment to the extent permitted by law.

---

**9. Work-Related Intellectual Property**  
All intellectual property, including but not limited to software code, documentation, system designs, and technical innovations, created by the Employee during the course of employment and relating to the Employer’s business shall be the sole and exclusive property of the Employer. The Employee shall execute any documents necessary to confirm or assign such rights, as required.

---

**10. Workplace Policies**  
The Employee shall comply with all applicable workplace policies, codes of conduct, IT security protocols, and remote work guidelines issued by the Employer from time to time, including those related to data protection, acceptable use of systems, and professional conduct. These policies shall be made available to the Employee in writing.

---

**11. Termination**  
Either party may terminate this employment by providing **seventy-five (75) days’ written notice** to the other party. In the event of termination by the Employer without notice, the Employer shall pay the Employee an amount equivalent to seventy-five (75) days of salary in lieu of notice. Termination shall be subject to compliance with applicable labour laws, including any requirements under the Industrial Disputes Act, 1947, if applicable.

---

**12. Dispute Resolution**  
Any dispute arising out of or in connection with this Agreement shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the competent courts in Haryana, India. The parties shall make reasonable efforts to resolve disputes amicably through mutual discussion before initiating legal proceedings.

---

**13. Governing Law**  
This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of India, including relevant central and state labour legislation applicable in Haryana.

---

**14. Entire Agreement**  
This document constitutes the entire understanding between the parties with respect to the subject matter herein and supersedes all prior discussions, representations, or agreements, whether oral or written.

---

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Agreement as of the date first written above.

**For [Employer Name]**  
_________________________  
Name:  
Designation:  
Date:  

**Employee**  
_________________________  
[Employee Name]  
Date:  

---  
*End of Agreement*

- Gratuity under the Payment of Gratuity Act, 1972, upon completion of five (5) years of continuous service;

The Employer shall deduct and contribute such amounts as required by law.

The Employee shall not, during or after the term of employment, disclose or use any confidential information, trade secrets, technical data, client information, or business processes of the Employer, except as required in the course of performing authorized duties. The Employee shall promptly disclose and assign all such Work-Related IP to the Employer and shall provide all necessary assistance to secure intellectual property rights.

The Employee shall comply with all applicable workplace policies, codes of conduct, safety regulations, and procedures issued by the Employer from time to time, including those related to data security, IT usage, harassment, and professional behavior.

### 12. **TERMINATION**

The Employer reserves the right to terminate the employment immediately upon payment of salary in lieu of notice, as permitted by law. Termination shall also be subject to the provisions of applicable labor laws.

---

### 13. **DISPUTE RESOLUTION**  
Any dispute arising out of or in connection with this Agreement shall be resolved amicably through mutual discussion. If unresolved, the dispute shall be subject to the **exclusive jurisdiction of the courts in Rajasthan, India**, and governed by the laws of India.

---

- This Agreement constitutes the entire understanding between the Parties and supersedes all prior discussions.

**EMPLOYMENT AGREEMENT**

This Employment Agreement ("Agreement") is made and entered into on this ___ day of __________, 20__, by and between:

**[Employer Name]**, a company incorporated under the laws of India, having its registered office at [Employer Address], Maharashtra, India,  
(hereinafter referred to as the "Employer"),

**AND**

**[Employee Full Name]**, an individual residing at [Employee Address], Maharashtra, India,  
(hereinafter referred to as the "Employee").

**WHEREAS**, the Employer wishes to employ the Employee in the position of Release Engineer, and the Employee desires to accept such employment, subject to the terms and conditions set forth herein.

**NOW, THEREFORE**, in consideration of the mutual covenants and promises contained herein, the parties agree as follows:

---

**1. APPOINTMENT AND COMMENCEMENT**  
The Employer hereby appoints the Employee to the position of **Release Engineer**, effective from **[Start Date]**. The Employee accepts such appointment and agrees to perform the duties and responsibilities associated with the role in accordance with this Agreement and applicable policies.

---

**2. DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**  
The Employee shall perform the duties and responsibilities typical of a Release Engineer, including but not limited to:  
- Managing software release cycles and deployment pipelines;  
- Coordinating with development, testing, and operations teams;  
- Ensuring version control, build integrity, and environment consistency;  
- Implementing and maintaining release automation tools;  
- Monitoring compliance with release protocols and security standards;  
- Performing such other duties as may be assigned by the Employer from time to time, consistent with the role.

The Employee shall perform these duties faithfully, diligently, and in the best interests of the Employer.

---

**3. WORKPLACE**  
The Employee shall work on a **fully remote basis** from a location of their choosing within Maharashtra, India. The Employee shall ensure a secure, reliable, and professional work environment and shall remain accessible during core working hours as required by the Employer.

---

**4. SALARY**  
The Employee shall receive a fixed annual salary of **INR 1,100,000 (Indian Rupees Eleven Lakh Only)**, payable in equal monthly installments in accordance with the Employer’s standard payroll practices, subject to applicable statutory deductions. This salary constitutes the full fixed compensation for the services rendered under this Agreement, excluding any variable or incentive components unless separately agreed in writing.

---

**5. PROBATION PERIOD**  
The Employee shall serve a probation period of **five (5) months**, commencing from the effective date of employment. During this period, the Employer shall evaluate the Employee’s performance, conduct, and suitability for continued employment. Upon successful completion of the probation period, the Employee’s appointment shall continue as a permanent employee, subject to the terms of this Agreement. Either party may terminate employment during probation with **thirty (30) days’ prior written notice**, without additional liability beyond accrued salary and statutory entitlements.

---

**6. WORKING TIME**  
The Employee shall work **forty-two (42) scheduled hours per week**, to be distributed across five (5) working days as per the Employer’s operational requirements. The Employee shall remain available during standard business hours unless alternate arrangements are approved in writing by the Employer. The Employee may be required to work additional hours as necessary to meet project deadlines, subject to compliance with applicable labor laws.

---

**7. LEAVE**  
The Employee shall be entitled to paid leave in accordance with the provisions of the **Factories Act, 1948**, and other applicable statutes, including but not limited to:  
- Earned Leave: As per applicable law;  
- Sick Leave: As per applicable law;  
- Casual Leave: As per company policy, subject to statutory minimums;  
- Public Holidays: As declared by the Government of Maharashtra.

Leave entitlements shall be administered in accordance with the Employer’s leave policy and applicable legal requirements.

---

**8. STATUTORY BENEFITS**  
The Employee shall be entitled to statutory benefits as required under Indian law, including but not limited to:  
- Employees’ Provident Fund (EPF) and Employees’ Pension Scheme (EPS) under the Employees’ Provident Funds and Miscellaneous Provisions Act, 1952;  
- Employees’ State Insurance (ESI), if applicable;  
- Gratuity under the Payment of Gratuity Act, 1972, upon completion of eligible service;  
- Any other benefits mandated by applicable central or state legislation.

The Employer shall deduct and contribute such amounts as required by law.

---

**9. CONFIDENTIALITY**  
The Employee shall not, during or after employment, disclose, use, or permit the use of any confidential information, trade secrets, technical data, business plans, or proprietary systems of the Employer, except as necessary to perform duties under this Agreement or as required by law. This obligation shall survive the termination of employment.

---

**10. WORK-RELATED INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY**  
All intellectual property, including but not limited to software code, documentation, designs, tools, and inventions, created, developed, or conceived by the Employee during the course of employment and relating to the Employer’s business, shall be the sole and exclusive property of the Employer. The Employee hereby assigns all rights, title, and interest in such work product to the Employer and shall execute any documents necessary to confirm such ownership.

---

**11. WORKPLACE POLICIES**  
The Employee shall comply with all applicable workplace policies, codes of conduct, data security protocols, and remote work guidelines issued by the Employer from time to time. The Employee acknowledges receipt and understanding of the current policies and agrees to remain updated on any revisions.

---

**12. TERMINATION**  
Either party may terminate this Agreement by providing **thirty (30) days’ prior written notice** to the other party. Upon termination, the Employee shall be entitled to all accrued salary, leave dues, and statutory benefits up to the date of separation. The Employer reserves the right to accept resignation or terminate employment with immediate effect by paying in lieu of notice, as permitted under applicable law.

Termination may also occur summarily for cause, including but not limited to misconduct, breach of policy, or violation of law, in accordance with due process and applicable labor statutes.

---

**13. DISPUTE RESOLUTION**  
Any dispute arising out of or in connection with this Agreement shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the competent courts in **Mumbai, Maharashtra, India**. The parties shall make reasonable efforts to resolve disputes amicably before initiating legal proceedings.

---

**14. GOVERNING LAW**  
This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of India, including but not limited to the Industrial Disputes Act, 1947, the Maharashtra Labour Laws, and other applicable central and state statutes.

---

**15. MISCELLANEOUS**  
- This Agreement constitutes the entire understanding between the parties and supersedes all prior discussions or agreements.  
- Amendments must be in writing and signed by both parties.  
- The Employee acknowledges that they have had the opportunity to review this Agreement and understand its terms.  
- The headings used herein are for convenience only and shall not affect interpretation.

---

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Agreement as of the date first written above.

[Employer Name]  
By: _________________________  
Name: [Authorized Signatory Name]  
Designation: [Designation]

**EMPLOYMENT AGREEMENT**

This Employment Agreement ("Agreement") is made on [DATE] between:

**[EMPLOYER NAME]**, a company registered under the laws of India, having its registered office at [EMPLOYER ADDRESS], West Bengal, India (hereinafter referred to as the "Employer")

And

**[EMPLOYEE NAME]**, residing at [EMPLOYEE ADDRESS], West Bengal, India (hereinafter referred to as the "Employee")

Collectively referred to as the "Parties".

---

**1. APPOINTMENT**  
The Employer hereby appoints the Employee to the position of **Release Engineer**, and the Employee accepts such appointment, subject to the terms and conditions of this Agreement.

---

**2. DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**  
The Employee shall perform the duties and responsibilities customary to the role of a Release Engineer, including but not limited to managing software build processes, coordinating release cycles, ensuring deployment stability, maintaining version control systems, and supporting continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines. The Employee shall report to the designated manager and perform all lawful and reasonable instructions assigned by the Employer.

---

**3. WORKPLACE**  
The Employee shall work remotely from a location of their choosing within West Bengal, India. The Employee shall ensure a suitable and secure work environment and maintain reliable internet connectivity and necessary equipment for performing their duties. The Employer reserves the right to require occasional in-person meetings or workplace visits with reasonable prior notice, subject to mutual agreement.

---

**4. SALARY AND PAYMENT**  
The Employee shall receive a fixed annual salary of **INR 700,000 (Seven Lakh Rupees)**, payable in equal monthly installments in accordance with the Employer’s standard payroll schedule, subject to applicable statutory deductions. The salary is exclusive of any variable or performance-linked compensation unless separately agreed in writing.

---

**5. PROBATION PERIOD**  
The Employee shall be on probation for a period of **four (4) months** from the date of joining. During this period, either Party may terminate this Agreement with **seven (7) days’ written notice**. Upon satisfactory completion of the probation period, the Employee’s position shall become confirmed, subject to the terms of this Agreement.

---

**6. WORKING TIME**  
The Employee shall be expected to work **forty-two (42) scheduled hours per week**, distributed over five (5) or six (6) days as operationally required. The Employee shall maintain time logs or availability as may be reasonably required by the Employer. The Employee shall be entitled to breaks in accordance with applicable labor laws and internal policies.

---

**7. LEAVE**  
The Employee shall be entitled to leave in accordance with applicable statutory provisions under the West Bengal Shops and Establishments Act and other relevant laws, including but not limited to:

- Paid earned leave
- Sick leave
- Casual leave
- Public and festival holidays as declared by the Employer

Leave entitlements shall accrue in accordance with applicable law and internal policy, and requests for leave shall be made in accordance with the Employer’s procedures.

---

**8. STATUTORY BENEFITS**  
The Employee shall be entitled to statutory benefits as required under applicable Indian laws, including but not limited to:

- Employees’ Provident Fund (EPF) and Employees’ Pension Scheme (EPS) under the Employees’ Provident Funds and Miscellaneous Provisions Act, 1952
- Employees’ State Insurance (ESI), if applicable based on salary threshold and employee count
- Payment of Bonus Act, 1965, if applicable
- Gratuity under the Payment of Gratuity Act, 1972, upon completion of eligible service

The Employer shall deduct and contribute amounts as required by law.

---

**9. CONFIDENTIALITY**  
The Employee shall not, during or after employment, disclose or use any confidential information, trade secrets, technical data, source code, customer information, or business strategies of the Employer, except as required in the course of their duties or as authorized in writing. This obligation shall survive termination of employment and shall be subject to applicable law.

---

**10. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY**  
All intellectual property created by the Employee during the course of employment, whether in whole or in part, and relating to the Employer’s business or using the Employer’s resources, shall be the sole and exclusive property of the Employer. The Employee shall promptly disclose and assign all such work product to the Employer and provide reasonable assistance in securing intellectual property rights.

---

**11. WORKPLACE POLICIES**  
The Employee shall comply with all lawful workplace policies, codes of conduct, IT security protocols, and remote work guidelines issued by the Employer from time to time, including policies on data protection, acceptable use of systems, and ethical behavior.

---

**12. TERMINATION**  
Either Party may terminate this Agreement by providing **thirty (30) days’ written notice** to the other Party. During the notice period, the Employee shall continue to perform their duties unless otherwise directed by the Employer. The Employer reserves the right to pay salary in lieu of notice, subject to applicable law.

Termination shall also be permissible summarily for cause, including but not limited to misconduct, breach of policy, or failure to perform duties, in accordance with applicable legal procedures.

---

**13. DISPUTE RESOLUTION**  
Any dispute arising out of or in connection with this Agreement shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts in Kolkata, West Bengal. The Parties shall endeavor to resolve disputes amicably through mutual discussion before initiating legal proceedings.

This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of India.

---

**14. MISCELLANEOUS**  
- This Agreement constitutes the entire understanding between the Parties and supersedes any prior discussions or agreements.  
- Amendments must be in writing and signed by both Parties.  
- If any provision is found unenforceable, the remainder of the Agreement shall remain in full force.  
- The headings are for convenience only and do not affect interpretation.

---

**IN WITNESS WHEREOF**, the Parties have executed this Agreement on the date first above written.

**For [EMPLOYER NAME]**  
Signature: _________________________  
Name: [AUTHORIZED REPRESENTATIVE NAME]  
Title: [DESIGNATION]  
Date: [DATE]

**Employee**  
Signature: _________________________  
Name: [EMPLOYEE NAME]  
Date: [DATE]
